objects.description: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has collected victim organization information including but not limited to organization hierarchy, functions, press releases, and others.(Citation: KISA Operation Muzabi) [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has also used large language models (LLMs) to gather information about potential targets of interest.(Citation: MSFT-AI)
